WITH battery AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BatteryLevel') AS avg_soc,
    AVG(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PackVoltage') AS avg_pack_v,
    AVG(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PackCurrent') AS avg_pack_a,
    AVG(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'EnergyRemaining') AS avg_energy_kwh
  FROM signal_log
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND field IN ('BatteryLevel', 'PackVoltage', 'PackCurrent', 'EnergyRemaining')
    AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
), charging AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(dc_charging_power_w) / 1000.0 AS peak_dc_kw,
    MAX(ac_charging_power_w) / 1000.0 AS peak_ac_kw
  FROM charging_telemetry
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT
  battery.avg_soc AS "🔋 Avg SOC",
  battery.avg_pack_v AS "⚡ Avg Pack V",
  battery.avg_pack_a AS "🔌 Avg Pack A",
  battery.avg_energy_kwh AS "🔋 Energy kWh",
  charging.peak_dc_kw AS "⚡ Peak DC kW",
  charging.peak_ac_kw AS "🔌 Peak AC kW"
FROM battery CROSS JOIN charging

SELECT ts AS time,
  MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PackVoltage') AS "Pack Voltage (V)",
  MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PackCurrent') AS "Pack Current (A)"
FROM signal_log
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND field IN ('PackVoltage', 'PackCurrent')
  AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  dc_charging_power_w / 1000.0 AS "DC Power (kW)",
  ac_charging_power_w / 1000.0 AS "AC Power (kW)"
FROM charging_telemetry
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND (dc_charging_power_w IS NOT NULL OR ac_charging_power_w IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BatteryLevel') AS "SOC %",
  convert_distance_m(MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'EstBatteryRange')) AS "Est Range",
  convert_distance_m(MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'RatedRange')) AS "Rated Range"
FROM signal_log
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND field IN ('BatteryLevel', 'EstBatteryRange', 'RatedRange')
  AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY ts
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BrickVoltageMax') AS "Max Cell V",
  MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BrickVoltageMin') AS "Min Cell V",
  (MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BrickVoltageMax') - MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BrickVoltageMin')) AS "Spread"
FROM signal_log
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND field IN ('BrickVoltageMax', 'BrickVoltageMin')
  AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY ts
HAVING MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'BrickVoltageMax') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts AS time,
  convert_temp(MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'ModuleTempMax')) AS "Max Module Temp",
  convert_temp(MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'ModuleTempMin')) AS "Min Module Temp"
FROM signal_log
WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
  AND field IN ('ModuleTempMax', 'ModuleTempMin')
  AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY ts
HAVING MAX(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8)) FILTER (WHERE field = 'ModuleTempMax') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ts

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT sl.int_value
     FROM signal_log sl
     WHERE sl.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
       AND sl.field = 'BMSState'
       AND sl.int_value IS NOT NULL
       AND sl.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
     ORDER BY sl.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS bms_state_code,
    (SELECT sl.bool_value
     FROM signal_log sl
     WHERE sl.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
       AND sl.field = 'BmsFullchargecomplete'
       AND sl.bool_value IS NOT NULL
       AND sl.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
     ORDER BY sl.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS full_charge,
    (SELECT ct.battery_heater_on
     FROM charging_telemetry ct
     WHERE ct.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
       AND ct.battery_heater_on IS NOT NULL
       AND ct.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
     ORDER BY ct.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS battery_heater_on,
    (SELECT ms.isolation_resistance_ohm
     FROM motor_snapshots ms
     WHERE ms.vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
       AND ms.isolation_resistance_ohm IS NOT NULL
       AND ms.ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
     ORDER BY ms.ts DESC LIMIT 1) AS isolation_ohm
)
SELECT
  CASE bms_state_code
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'Standby' WHEN 2 THEN 'Drive'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Support' WHEN 4 THEN 'Charge' WHEN 5 THEN 'FEIM'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Clear Fault' WHEN 7 THEN 'Fault' WHEN 8 THEN 'Weld'
    WHEN 9 THEN 'Test' WHEN 10 THEN 'SNA'
    ELSE CASE WHEN bms_state_code IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE 'Code ' || bms_state_code::text END
  END AS "BMS State",
  CASE full_charge WHEN TRUE THEN 'Yes' WHEN FALSE THEN 'No' ELSE 'N/A' END AS "Full Charge",
  CASE battery_heater_on WHEN TRUE THEN 'On' WHEN FALSE THEN 'Off' ELSE 'N/A' END AS "Battery Heater",
  ROUND(isolation_ohm::numeric) AS "Isolation Ω"
FROM latest

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT
    last(int_value, ts) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PowershareStatus') AS status_code,
    last(int_value, ts) FILTER (WHERE field = 'PowershareType') AS type_code,
    last(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8), ts)
      FILTER (WHERE field = 'PowershareHoursLeft') AS hours_left,
    last(COALESCE(float_value, int_value::float8), ts)
      FILTER (WHERE field = 'PowershareInstantaneousPowerKW') AS power_kw
  FROM signal_log
  WHERE vehicle_id = ${vehicle_id}
    AND field IN ('PowershareStatus', 'PowershareType',
                  'PowershareHoursLeft', 'PowershareInstantaneousPowerKW')
    AND ts BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT
  CASE status_code
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN 2 THEN 'Handshaking'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Initializing' WHEN 4 THEN 'Enabled'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Enabled (reconnecting soon)' WHEN 6 THEN 'Stopped'
    ELSE CASE WHEN status_code IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE 'Code ' || status_code::text END
  END AS "Status",
  CASE type_code
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Unknown' WHEN 1 THEN 'None' WHEN 2 THEN 'Load' WHEN 3 THEN 'Home'
    ELSE CASE WHEN type_code IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE 'Code ' || type_code::text END
  END AS "Type",
  hours_left AS "Hours Left",
  ROUND(power_kw::numeric, 1) AS "Power kW"
FROM latest
WHERE status_code IS NOT NULL
